name: Vivaron
isnote: PBDB places it in Rauisuchidae (a grade of 'rauisuchians'); the atlas keeps that parent.
sum: Vivaron is a rauisuchid from the Late Triassic (middle Norian) Chinle Formation of New Mexico.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
